cover: Cyber chaos strikes European infrastructure and war alerts as global tensions surge
cover_scene: A split composition showing digital warning screens flashing red across dark city skylines in Europe and naval warships positioned in a foggy strait.

slides.scene: Rows of commercial supermarket freezers with frost melting away under harsh grocery aisle lighting across an empty European store.
slides.headline: Widespread European Supermarket Fridges Hit by Cyberattack
slides.body: Hackers targeted commercial refrigeration systems across Europe, causing freezer temperatures to soar up to fifty degrees Celsius and spoiling vast food supplies at retailers like Ikea. Operators in multiple countries are scrambling to secure climate networks and assess mounting food waste.

slides.scene: Naval frigates and a commercial oil tanker navigating the narrow waters of the Strait of Hormuz with Iranian and Qatari flags visible.
slides.headline: Strait of Hormuz Proposal Awaits US Response
slides.body: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi confirmed ongoing talks mediated by Qatar regarding a two-day initiative for the Strait of Hormuz. Implementation of any maritime transit agreement now hinges entirely on an official decision from the United States government.

slides.scene: A crowded Wall Street trading floor glowing green under massive overhead financial ticker boards showing rising stock indexes.
slides.headline: Wall Street Rebounds After Five Trillion Drop
slides.body: Major American stock indexes rallied after suffering a five trillion dollar sell-off sparked by artificial intelligence valuation fears. Lower crude oil prices and bargain hunting helped stabilize equities as investors await critical corporate earnings and upcoming economic data.

slides.scene: Futuristic glass research facilities in Seoul glowing with blue circuit patterns against a nighttime metropolitan backdrop.
slides.headline: South Korea Commits Billions to Artificial Intelligence
slides.body: The South Korean government announced a multibillion-dollar investment package dedicated to strengthening its domestic artificial intelligence sector. Officials designed the aggressive funding strategy to secure the nation's position as a dominant global leader in next-generation computing.

slides.scene: A modern stadium in Dakar, Senegal illuminated under evening skies with flags of African nations flying above.
slides.headline: Senegal Hosts Africa First Olympic Games
slides.body: Senegal welcomed delegates and athletes as it prepares to host Africa's first Olympic event through the Youth Olympic Games, per Al Jazeera. Olympic officials highlighted the historic milestone as a transformative development for African sporting infrastructure and global recognition.
